Name: Aimon's Fancy Greenhouse
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Arial][color=#ffe599][size=3]Gives your greenhouse interior more fancy look with some optional additions! Heavily inspired by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Gwen's Medieval Buildings[/url]  [/size][/color]

[color=#93c47d][size=4][b][u]Features:[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Simple yet convenient greenhouse remap[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Recolor options[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Dig and plant crops and trees on almost any tile[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Lightbeams from windows [/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Change flooring and wallpapers by your own choice [/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Place furniture on walls  such as lamps and banners[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Place casks anywhere inside[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Little fountain pond in which you can fish  (you can catch carps, green and white algae in it)[/size][/font]
[/list]
[size=2]Recolors, pond, lightbeams and cellar entrances are fully configurable - you can disable or enable them in mod's config. ([/size][/font][font=Arial][url=http:///www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=2] is highly recommended.)[/size]

[size=4][u][b][color=#b6d7a8]Config:[/color]
[/b][/u][/size][/font][font=Arial]
[list]
[*][font=Arial]  Recolor:[/font]
[/list][size=1] [/size][size=2]﻿﻿-Vanilla,
﻿﻿-[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town (dark/white)[/url], 
﻿﻿-[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral,[/url]
﻿﻿-[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1074]Elegant VIctorian Interior[/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1869]  
﻿﻿-Starblue Valley[/url][/size]
[list]
[*][font=Arial]  Lightbeams - on/off[/font]
[*][font=Arial]  Floor Borders - on/off [/font]
[*][font=Arial]  Fountain  - on/off [/font]
[*][font=Arial]  Cellar [/font][font=Arial][size=2] - on/off [/size][/font]
[/list][color=#ff7700][size=5][b][u]
[/u][/b][/size][/color][/font][u][b][color=#93c47d][size=5]FAQ[/size][/color][/b][/u]
[color=#ffe599][size=3][u][b]Compatibility:[/b][/u][/size][/color][font=Arial]
[/font] [font=Arial][list]
[*]Comatible with any recolor
[*]Compatibe with SVE, RSV and any other expansion mod
[*]﻿Not compatible with mods that change greenhouse map
[/list] [/font]
[color=#ffe599][size=3][u][b]Installation:
﻿[/b][/u][/size][/color]﻿1. Install all the required mods
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿ ﻿2. (optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu to be able to change options ingame
﻿ ﻿3. Place "Aimon's Fancy Greenhouse" from mod's zip archive into your main Mods folder
﻿4. ﻿Done!
NOTE: ﻿For stardew 1.5.6 you'll also need Extra Map Layers and Custom Decoration Areas mod
[b][color=#cc4125]
[/color][u][color=#e06666][size=3]Bugs&Issues:
[/size][/color][/u][/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]This mod is safe to install on already existing saves, [u][color=#ff7700]but if you used other greenhouse remap mod previosly (like Oasis Greenhouse and such) - some of your trees and crops may shift their places or even disappear[/color][/u] (since most of greenhouse mods make greenhosue map wider, after deinstalling it, all the stuff you placed in those expanded areas may just disappear). [/size]
[/list][size=2]To avoid this - [u][color=#ff7700]before deinstalling your previous greenhouse mod - pick up all your stuff from those expanded areas[/color][/u] (casks, chests, furniture...). You can't move  fruit trees and crops that you placed in those modded extra areas, so they will probably disappear anyways. 
Same goes with deinstalling my greenhouse mod - before doing so, better pick up all your stuff (especially all the casks from cellar area).
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]You can dig some tiles around walls, so visually it will look like hoed dirt on the walls. It's not a big deal, just remove the hoed tile with pickaxe or other tools.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=2]Sometimes you'll catch trash items in fountain pond - unfixable, just deal with it.[/size]
[/list]
